pages.title: The Overworld
pages.text: By default, the Overworld uses the $(thing)Classic Overworld$() terrain generator, providing a somewhat different terrain experience from vanilla Minecraft.$(br2)$(important)Ore distribution is significantly different$() — you'll need to explore carefully to find the resources needed for progression.$(br2)$(note)Some ores can only be generated in other dimensions.$()

pages.title: Ore Progression
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Copper Ore$() — Distribution is largely consistent with vanilla Minecraft, often found in shallower layers. Smelt vanilla Copper Ingots again to obtain your first metal.$(li)$(item)Silver Ore$() — A precious metal found at medium depths.$(li)$(item)Mithril Ore$() — Rare deep ore. Mine with an Iron Pickaxe, smelt in an Obsidian Furnace.$()$(li)$(item)Adamantium Ore$() — The rarest deep ore. Mine with a Mithril Pickaxe, smelt in a Netherrack Furnace.

pages.title: The Underworld
pages.text: A new dimension accessible by constructing a portal at the $(thing)bottom of the Overworld$().$(br)$(bold)Characteristics:$()$(li)Height: -64 to 320 (384 blocks tall)$()$(li)Space is distributed across different layers, with an underground lake layer often on the surface.$(li)Has a ceiling$(li)Single fixed biome$(li)You $(thing)cannot sleep$() here$(li)Large numbers of dangerous mobs spawn$(br2)Entering the Underworld rewards $(thing)200 XP and 3 Blocks of Iron$().

pages.title: Underworld Resources
pages.text: The Underworld is rich in resources — this is where you'll find the advanced materials needed for progression:$(li2)$(item)Copper Ore$() — Abundant in the Underworld$(li2)$(item)Iron and Gold Ore$()$(li2)$(item)Mithril Ore$() — Sometimes found on the surface$(li2)$(item)Adamantium Ore$() — Abundantly distributed at y=-50$(li2)$(item)Diamond and Redstone Ore$()$(li2)$(item)Lapis Lazuli Ore$()$(li2)$(item)Silver Ore$()

pages.title: The Nether
pages.text: Travel to the deepest layer of the Underworld to construct a Nether portal — a lengthy endeavor that rewards $(thing)500 XP and 3 Blocks of Iron$().$(br2)In the Nether you'll find $(item)Ancient Debris$() for crafting Netherite, and $(thing)Piglin Bastion$() treasure rooms containing rare loot.

pages.title: Reaching the Nether
pages.text: Start digging straight down from beneath your feet, carving a mineshaft straight to the bottom. If you encounter a bedrock layer, you'll need to find a way around it, expanding sideways to find gaps to continue downward, until you reach a large lava sea at y=-60.$(br2)Stand at y=-60 and build your portal — activate it to enter the Nether.$(br2)$(note)You may encounter rare ore veins while digging your mineshaft.$()

pages.title: Explore Further
pages.text: Learn about the creatures that inhabit these dimensions and how to survive them.
